reuse.basis: Page footer licenses content CC BY 4.0 except as otherwise noted; factual numeric extraction only
reuse.attribution: Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 model card. Accessed 2026-10-19.
reuse.notes: Metadata and brief independently written factual records only; no implication of endorsement. Not a claim that the whole source is openly licensed.

coverage.population: Three specific model variants across six developer-reported tests
coverage.included: 18 populated records; Three specific model variants across six developer-reported tests
coverage.omitted: Other models, energy/latency measurements, task-specific confidence intervals and independent reruns
coverage.missingness: Unlisted entities are missing, not zero.

uncertainty: No cross-benchmark average or universal score. Thinking modes differ from the older comparator; architecture, training and inference budget confound size-only conclusions. E4B is an effective-size label, not simply total parameter count.

transform.description: Manual transcription of factual values/categories; no interpolation, imputation or causal inference.
transform.validation: Each row carries a source locator; categorical values separately label plans, policies and observed events.

verification.method: Read primary source and compare each extracted record to its named source location.

scoring.reason: No universal extremity or impact score is supported by these data.

forecast.reason: No validated forecast was supplied. Policy intentions and planned installations are not predictions.

limitations: Developer evaluation dates are not reported in the model card. Page last updated 2026-07-30 is not a test date.
Gemma 4 Thinking versus Gemma 3 no-think confounds causal comparison of parameter count.
Landing page and model card differ in one benchmark label and Tau2 scope; this extract uses the authoritative model card throughout.
